description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ARi is seeking an entry-level Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test Linux-based software applications and middleware. The role supports infotainment, communication, and connectivity features for embedded electronic platforms.
Embedded Software Engineer developing Linux applications and middleware for infotainment, connectivity, and Ethernet/TCP/IP networking

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, debug, and test embedded software applications and middleware running on Linux-based platforms
• Develop embedded software components using C, C++, or Rust
• Support the development and integration of infotainment, connectivity, and communication software features
• Develop and maintain Linux-based applications, services, and middleware components
• Implement and troubleshoot communication interfaces and networking protocols, including Ethernet, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi
• Support integration of Bluetooth, wireless, and cellular communication technologies into embedded systems
• Perform software debugging, unit testing, integration testing, and functional validation
• Troubleshoot software issues related to application performance, communication interfaces, and embedded Linux environments
• Collaborate with software developers, hardware engineers, and systems engineers to integrate software components into embedded electronic platforms
• Participate in code reviews, software documentation, and development activities
• Support testing and validation of embedded infotainment and connectivity features

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering
• Recent graduate
• Academic coursework, laboratory experience, internships, or technical projects involving embedded software development
• Hands-on experience developing software applications on embedded Linux platforms
• Programming experience in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Rust
• Understanding of Linux application development, middleware, processes, and system-level software concepts
• Knowledge of networking and communication protocols, including Ethernet, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi
• Experience developing or integrating software for connected embedded devices through academic projects, internships, or laboratory work
• Familiarity with software debugging, troubleshooting, and testing techniques
• Strong understanding of embedded systems fundamentals and software/hardware interactions

Preferred:
• preferably graduating in December 2026
• available to begin employment in January 2027
• Academic or internship experience developing infotainment, multimedia, or connected-device applications
• Experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or cellular communication software
• Exposure to embedded Linux platforms such as Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, or similar development boards
• Experience with Linux middleware, inter-process communication (IPC), or application frameworks
• Familiarity with Linux networking, sockets, and communication interfaces
• Experience with embedded device drivers, hardware interfaces, or system integration
• Knowledge of Git, software build systems, and debugging tools
• Experience with automotive, industrial, or off-highway infotainment and connectivity systems
• Familiarity with real-time embedded systems, cross-compilation, or embedded Linux development environments
